claim: The MAGE method. Scale creates the enduring reasoning problem; commodity intelligence changes its economics. Modeling makes consequential engineering properties explicit and available to analysis; Alignment makes selected obligations enforceable. Governance conversion turns recurring failures and judgment into models and controls that future work can reuse, so engineering effort can accumulate instead of being paid for again.

topology.description: Restored the abstract-or-reconstruct state phrase and causal edge annotations for scarcity, exposed properties, economic change, and future value versus upkeep. Retained Modeling and Alignment gray modes, dashed churn alternatives, governance feedback, and dotted scope feedback.

redesign: One 8% role marks the two named MAGE principles equally; ordinary conditions, outcomes and feedback nodes white. Vertical causal chain; orthogonal dashed churn branches. Outer dotted scope feedback and left governance feedback remain because these named loops are the argument.
alt: A vertical causal chain runs from scale and finite reasoning through scarce judgment, Modeling, Alignment and the governed engineering environment to engineering capital. Commodity intelligence enters from the left; dashed branches lead to churn on the right. Governance conversion feeds back to Modeling, and a dotted outer loop shows greater scope reopening the reasoning problem.
